text:
priya: Noticed a recurring analytics drift: hourly rollups for active_account_count are consistently ~8-12% below raw events for the last 3 occurrences (2024-08-12 01:00, 2024-08-26 01:00, 2024-09-09 01:00 UTC). Looks like missing span events during the ETL commit window.

mike: can you share an example diff?

priya: sample: rollup.hourly_active_accounts (2024-09-09T01:00) expected=5,430 actual=4,996. Raw event log shows ingestion commit timeout on put-shard-12.

esther: shard-12 again? that's the one that lost connectivity during autoscaler spin-up last month. Might be related to the recent autoscaler bump.

chris: I think this is the long-tail pattern we've seen. Two suggested tracks: hotfix to fail loudly on commit so we don't silently drop spans, and a medium-term change to add pre-commit buffering with persisted acks.

priya: agree. Also want to track remediation ownership & cadence so items don't drift. Proposal: create 3 action items with owners and timelines.

priya: Action items: 
- A1 (owner: mike) deploy hotfix to make commit failures generate an incident and replay queue push (ETA: 8h)
- A2 (owner: esther) audit autoscaler interactions and revert suspect config if needed (ETA: 48h)
- A3 (owner: chris) design durable pre-commit buffer + backpressure plan (ETA: design doc in 2w)

mike: I'll take A1. Plan: add a non-silent exception, instrument ETL.commit_failures counter, and create an alert if commit_failures > 0.05% over 10m. Canary then roll.

ops-bot: reminder: please include runbook updates and playbook entries when closing incident tasks.

esther: I'll start the audit. Quick note: recurring pattern every ~2 weeks after infra changes. I'll add a recurring check to the incident tracker and push a small metric for "in-flight commit retries".

priya: hotfix checklist for mike:
```
- add ETL.commit_failures counter + tag (shard_id)
- throw on commit error (do not swallow)
- create alert: ETL.commit_failures_rate > 0.05% (10m)
- deploy to canary shard-12 then rollout
- validate by comparing raw vs rollup for 2 windows
```

mike: creating PR now: https://github.com/redwood/etl/pull/1054 (span-commit-guard). Will post CI and canary link. ETA 6-8h.

priya: logging OBS ticket OBS-2320 for dashboard + playbook. Please include a tile for 'hourly rollup delta pct' and a playbook entry to run backfill if delta > 5% for 2 consecutive hours.

chris: I'll own the playbook text for backfill. Draft snippet: 
```
1) pause hourly-rollup job for affected window
2) run backfill: scripts/rebuild_rollups --start=2024-09-09T00:00 --end=2024-09-09T02:00 --shard=12
3) compare rollup vs raw counts, run acceptance checks
4) resume job
5) document incident in tracker and escalate to platform if repeat
```

mike: incident-bot: canary deploy started on shard-12 at 2024-09-09T10:30Z :rocket:

mike: canary stable after 25m, no commit errors observed. Rolling out to remaining shards.

priya: updated tracker: A1 done (mike) 8h; A2 audit (esther) in progress, initial findings due 2024-09-11; A3 design (chris) kickoff 2024-09-16. Added weekly reminders until OBS-2320 closed.

esther: audit note: autoscaler config "scale_threshold_ms" was lowered in last change, likely causing noisy evictions during burst. Opening revert PR and adding mitigating metric.

chris: adding design ticket INF-404 for pre-commit buffer; will loop in database and infra teams.

priya: final asks: mike update runbook with hotfix steps and confirm alert ownership; esther coordinate with infra on revert; chris to produce design doc. Next sync: 2024-09-11 16:00 UTC.

mike: will update runbook and alert ownership now.

priya: thanks all. Closing thread for now; will reopen if hourly delta resurfaces or if backfill required. :white_check_mark:
